title: A session working with no task recorded is told, behind the scenes, to work from a known task

fields.why: TJ often sees 'Working, no task recorded' on panes; the agent should be reminded invisibly to open or start a ticket

text: App shows the badge when phase=working and no owned in_progress ticket (Snapshot.swift sessionStatus ~L263, read-only: held by another session). Inject via hook additionalContext, as lib/ask.mjs cmdDeliver does (dedup via liveDir()/seen). Hooks run 'genlock session-state' (lib/voice.mjs). Nudge once per turn/cooldown on real work (edits, bash), not reads; never for the Assistant (GENLOCK_APP_PROJECTS); stop when the badge would clear. Tests in tests/run.mjs. Restart app only with open -g.

fields.user_said: Feel free to spin off a new session ... a message needs to be injected into the prompt (behind the scenes?! Possible?!) that tells the agent they need to be working from a known task

text: In an app session that owns no open ticket, an Edit/Write/Bash PostToolUse makes session-state print hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext telling the agent to open or start a ticket
check: node tests/run.mjs (check: 'an untracked edit is nudged')

text: The nudge is sent at most once per turn: a second tool in the same turn is silent, and the next UserPromptSubmit re-arms it
No nudge for reads (Read/Grep/Glob), for Bash running genlock itself, in the Assistant (GENLOCK_APP_PROJECTS set), or outside the app (no GENLOCK_APP_CHANNEL)
check: node tests/run.mjs (checks: 'reads are not nudged', 'genlock commands are not nudged', 'the Assistant is never nudged')

text: No nudge once the session owns an open ticket (owner = session_id or GENLOCK_SESSION, status draft/open/in_progress/blocked), matching when the app's badge clears
check: node tests/run.mjs (check: 'a session with a task is not nudged')

text: session-state still records state.json exactly as before, and the full suite passes

evidence: tests/run.mjs 'an untracked edit is nudged' passes: Edit PostToolUse prints hookSpecificOutput{hookEventName:PostToolUse, additionalContext:'...no task recorded...'}; live repo: session nobody-xyz -> nudge JSON
tests 'once per turn: a second change in the same turn is silent' (out='') and 'once per turn: the next prompt re-arms it' (nudge after UserPromptSubmit) both pass
tests pass: Read -> out=''; Bash 'cd /x && genlock new' -> out=''; GENLOCK_APP_PROJECTS=/projects -> out=''; existing 'with no app listening it does nothing' still passes
test 'a session with a task is not nudged' passes after nudge-1 opens a ticket; live repo: session 644921a9 (owns T-ZK4G2) -> no output
node tests/run.mjs -> 416 passed, 0 failed (was 404 state checks unchanged; 12 new); state.json checks untouched and 'the app still hears it is working' passes

answers.observed: suite 416/0 and two live hook runs against this repo, outputs quoted in evidence
answers.absence: not seen inside a running app pane yet: hooks call the genlock CLI each time, so no rebuild is needed, but no live pane was watched
answers.assumption: badge rule mirrored from Snapshot.sessionFocus: owner in session ids + open state; the app's agents set can hold more ids (after clear-context), so a cleared session might be nudged while the app shows its task
answers.falsify: an app pane with an owned open ticket receiving the reminder

text: Nudge built in lib/voice.mjs cmdSessionState: PostToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit/Bash (not genlock cmds), once per turn (channel/nudged, cleared on UserPromptSubmit), skipped for Assistant/no records/owned open ticket. 12 tests; suite 416/0. Not committed.
